OpusClip vs VEXI: AI Clipper or Social Media in One App?
OpusClip turns long videos into short clips. VEXI does that too, and also writes, designs and posts everything else, on Autopilot.
OpusClip is very good at one job: clipping long videos. Here is how it compares with one app that runs the whole feed.

OpusClip turns long videos into short clips with AI: it finds the moments, reframes them, adds captions and B-roll, and writes titles, descriptions and hashtags. Pro and Business include a social media scheduler; Starter does not. Starter is $15 a month and Pro is $29 a month, and there is a no-cost tier with watermarked clips kept for three days.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is where it starts. OpusClip needs a long video you already have. A feed also needs posts made from a photo, an idea or nothing at all, designed in your brand, every week. VEXI starts from anything and keeps posting. VEXI costs more than OpusClip: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
It Needs A Long Video First
OpusClip clips long videos. With no podcast or long recording to feed it, there is nothing to clip.
VEXI starts from anything: a photo, a clip, a link or nothing at all. Send a long recording and you get its best clips back too.
OpusClip is built to make video clips. Branded graphics, carousels and still posts come from another app.
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Scheduler Only On Pro And Up
OpusClip's pricing page says Starter has no social media scheduler. Scheduling starts on Pro.
Some Trustpilot reviewers report pressure to buy more credits and charges that continued after they asked to cancel.

Does VEXI do what OpusClip does?

For clipping, yes: send VEXI a long recording like a podcast and you get its best clips back, captioned. VEXI also makes posts from a photo, a link or an idea, designs them in your brand, and posts them.
Does OpusClip post to social media?
Yes, on Pro and Business. OpusClip's pricing page says Starter has no social media scheduler.
Starter is $15 a month and Pro is $29 a month, with Business priced on request. A no-cost tier exports watermarked clips that are kept for three days, and new users get a 7-day trial of Pro.
What do Trustpilot reviewers say about OpusClip?
OpusClip is rated 4.0 on Trustpilot. Some reviewers report charges that continued after cancelling, support that is hard to reach, and pressure to buy more credits.
